title.sk: Pečený losos so zemiakmi a kôprom
title.en: Baked salmon with potatoes and dill

description.sk: Celá večera z jedného plechu, plná bielkovín.
description.en: A whole dinner from one tray, full of protein.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Zemiaky nakrájaj na mesiačiky, premiešaj s olejom, cesnakom a polovicou soli a peč 20 minút.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with the oil, garlic and half the salt and bake for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj na plech ružičky brokolice a lososa, osoľ, okoreň a polož naň plátky citróna.
steps.en: Add the broccoli florets and the salmon to the tray, season and top the salmon with lemon slices.

steps.sk: Peč 12 až 15 minút, kým sa losos v strede ľahko rozdeľuje na lupienky a je ešte šťavnatý.
steps.en: Bake for 12–15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily in the centre but is still moist.

steps.sk: Posyp kôprom a podávaj.
steps.en: Sprinkle with dill and serve.

title.sk: Pečené kuracie stehná so zeleninou z plechu

description.sk: Mäso aj príloha naraz v rúre – ideálne do krabičiek.
description.en: Meat and sides in the oven at once, ideal for lunch boxes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 210 °C. Zemiaky, mrkvu, cibuľu a papriku nakrájaj na rovnako veľké kusy.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Cut the potatoes, carrots, onion and pepper into even pieces.

steps.sk: Zeleninu aj mäso premiešaj s olejom, paprikou, cesnakom, rozmarínom, soľou a korením a rozlož na plech v jednej vrstve.
steps.en: Toss the vegetables and chicken with the oil, paprika, garlic, rosemary, salt and pepper and spread in a single layer on a tray.

steps.sk: Peč 35 minút, v polovici premiešaj. Kura je hotové, keď má zlatú kôrku a vnútri dosiahne 75 °C – šťava je číra.
steps.en: Roast for 35 minutes, stirring halfway. The chicken is done when golden and 75 °C inside, with clear juices.

steps.sk: Rozdeľ do krabičiek; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Divide into containers; keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Šošovicový šalát s fetou a zeleninou
title.en: Lentil salad with feta and vegetables

description.sk: Svieži šalát do krabičky, ktorý vydrží v chladničke až tri dni.
description.en: A fresh lunch-box salad that keeps in the fridge for up to three days.

steps.sk: Šošovicu var v osolenej vode 20 minút, kým nie je mäkká, ale drží tvar. Sceď a nechaj vychladnúť.
steps.en: Simmer the lentils in salted water for 20 minutes until tender but holding their shape. Drain and cool.

steps.sk: Dresing: olej vyšľahaj s octom, horčicou a soľou.
steps.en: Dressing: whisk the oil with the vinegar, mustard and salt.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj šošovicu s nakrájanou zeleninou, petržlenovou vňaťou a dresingom a navrch rozdrob fetu.
steps.en: Toss the lentils with the chopped vegetables, parsley and dressing and crumble the feta on top.

title.sk: Quinoa miska s pečenou zeleninou a tahini
title.en: Quinoa bowl with roasted vegetables and tahini

description.sk: Farebná rastlinná miska plná vlákniny a bielkovín.
description.en: A colourful plant-based bowl full of fibre and protein.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 210 °C. Batát nakrájaj na kocky, brokolicu na ružičky a cibuľu na mesiačiky. Spolu s cícerom premiešaj s olejom, paprikou a polovicou soli.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Dice the sweet potato, cut the broccoli into florets and the onion into wedges. Toss with the chickpeas, oil, paprika and half the salt.

steps.sk: Peč 25 minút, v polovici premiešaj.
steps.en: Roast for 25 minutes, stirring halfway.

steps.sk: Quinou prepláchni a var v 360 ml osolenej vody 15 minút, kým nevsiakne vodu.
steps.en: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 360 ml salted water for 15 minutes until absorbed.

steps.sk: Tahini rozmiešaj s citrónovou šťavou, cesnakom, zvyšnou soľou a 3 lyžicami vody. Do misiek daj quinou, zeleninu a polej omáčkou.
steps.en: Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, garlic, remaining salt and 3 tablespoons of water. Fill bowls with quinoa and vegetables and drizzle with the sauce.

description.sk: Zamatová jesenná polievka s kokosovým mliekom a pražnými semienkami.
description.en: A velvety autumn soup with coconut milk and toasted seeds.

steps.sk: Na oleji speň cibuľu, cesnak a nastrúhaný zázvor.
steps.en: Soften the onion, garlic and grated ginger in the oil.

steps.sk: Pridaj tekvicu nakrájanú na kocky (hokkaido sa nemusí šúpať), bujón a 800 ml vody a var 20 minút doměkka.
steps.en: Add the diced pumpkin (no need to peel hokkaido), the stock cube and 800 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj kokosové mlieko, rozmixuj dohladka a dochuť soľou.
steps.en: Stir in the coconut milk, blend until smooth and season with salt.

steps.sk: Semienka opraž na suchej panvici a posyp nimi polievku.
steps.en: Toast the seeds in a dry pan and sprinkle them over the soup.

description.sk: Sýte raňajky pred tréningom – 40 g bielkovín v miske.
description.en: A filling pre-workout breakfast with 40 g of protein in a bowl.

steps.sk: Vločky s mliekom var za stáleho miešania 4 minúty, kým kaša nezhustne.
steps.en: Simmer the oats in the milk for 4 minutes, stirring, until thick.

steps.sk: Odstav a vmiešaj proteín – až mimo ohňa, inak by sa zrazil. Ak je kaša hustá, pridaj lyžicu vody.
steps.en: Take off the heat and stir in the protein powder; adding it off the heat stops it clumping. Loosen with a spoonful of water if needed.

steps.sk: Navrch daj nakrájaný banán, arašidové maslo a škoricu.
steps.en: Top with sliced banana, peanut butter and cinnamon.

description.sk: Hotový za 10 minút bez varenia, plný bielkovín a vlákniny.
description.en: Ready in 10 minutes with no cooking, full of protein and fibre.

steps.sk: Fazuľu prepláchni a odkvapkaj, paradajky rozpoľ a cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké krúžky.
steps.en: Rinse and drain the beans, halve the tomatoes and slice the onion into thin rings.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj s odkvapkaným tuniakom a petržlenovou vňaťou.
steps.en: Mix with the drained tuna and parsley.

steps.sk: Zalej olejom a citrónovou šťavou, osoľ, okoreň a premiešaj.
steps.en: Dress with the oil and lemon juice, season and toss.

title.sk: Čokoládový koláč z hrnčeka v mikrovlnke
title.en: Chocolate mug cake in the microwave

description.sk: Teplý dezert pre jedného za päť minút.
description.en: A warm dessert for one in five minutes.

steps.sk: Vo veľkom hrnčeku zmiešaj múku, kakao, cukor, prášok do pečiva a soľ.
steps.en: Mix the flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large mug.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj mlieko a olej dohladka a do stredu zapichni kúsky čokolády.
steps.en: Stir in the milk and oil until smooth and push the chocolate pieces into the middle.

steps.sk: Ohrievaj na plný výkon 70 až 90 sekúnd, kým koláč nevykysne a povrch nestuhne. Nechaj minútu postáť.
steps.en: Microwave on full power for 70–90 seconds until risen and set on top. Let it stand for a minute.
